process_area.title: Counter Operations — Bills Payment, Remittance, E-Money & Mobile Load

value_stream.name: In-Store Value-Added Services & Financial Agency Operations

fields.Frequency: Per transaction (high frequency at target stores)

Automation Opportunity: - Aggregator-integrated validation; BIR-receipt automation; cash-transaction reconciliation
Controls: - CTL-699 (ensure controlled execution — Counter Operations — Bills Payment, Remittance, E-Money & Mobile Load (PA-156.2).)
- CTL-699: transaction validated before posting; BIR-receipt issued (VS-79); cash reconciled daily (SoD)
Cross-references: - links to W4602 (aggregator), W4608 (systems), VS-08.2 (cash), VS-79/W4620 (BIR), VS-142 (cash handling), W4613 (reconciliation), W4615 (exceptions)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Posting-error risk**: Wrong biller/amount posted → customer loss; mitigated by validation & confirmation
- **Cash-shortage risk**: Cash ≠ transactions (VS-142/VS-23); mitigated by end-of-day reconciliation & SoD
System Touchpoints: - VAS terminal/aggregator (W4602/W4608); cash mgmt (VS-08.2); BIR receipt (VS-79/W4620); GL (VS-17)

steps.activity: Counter Staff process the bills-payment (select biller, enter account/reference/amount, validate per aggregator W4602), collect cash, and confirm posting
Counter Staff issue the official receipt/transaction record (BIR-compliant cash receipt VS-79/W4620), and capture the transaction to the VAS system (W4608)
Counter Staff handle any posting exception/error (W4615), and reconcile cash to transactions at end-of-day (W4613)

Automation Opportunity: - Principal-integrated remittance; KYC/threshold automation; AML-suspicious-transaction flagging
Controls: - CTL-699 (ensure controlled execution — Counter Operations — Bills Payment, Remittance, E-Money & Mobile Load (PA-156.2).)
- CTL-699: sender/receiver KYC (W4614); AML thresholds/reporting as agent (VS-86/W4619); cash reconciled (SoD)
Cross-references: - links to W4603 (principal), W4608 (systems), VS-86/W4619 (AML), VS-08.2 (cash), VS-79/W4620 (receipt), W4613 (reconciliation), W4614 (KYC)
Pain Points / Risks: - **AML-exposure risk**: Remittance misuse (layering/smurfing); mitigated by agent KYC + AML reporting (VS-86/W4619)
- **Mis-disbursement risk**: Paying wrong receiver → loss; mitigated by receiver KYC/ID verification
System Touchpoints: - Principal integration (W4603/W4608); AML (VS-86/W4619); cash mgmt (VS-08.2); receipt (VS-79/W4620); GL (VS-17)

steps.activity: Counter Staff process the remittance (sender/receiver KYC W4614, amount, destination), apply AML/threshold checks as agent (VS-86/W4619), and confirm via principal (W4603)
Counter Staff collect/disperse cash (send = collect; receive = disperse), issue receipt/reference, and capture to VAS system (W4608)
Counter Staff/AML handle threshold/AML exceptions (W4615/W4619), report suspicious transactions (VS-86), and reconcile cash (W4613)

Controls: - CTL-699 (ensure controlled execution — Counter Operations — Bills Payment, Remittance, E-Money & Mobile Load (PA-156.2).)
- CTL-699: customer verified (OTP/ID); AML thresholds/reporting as agent (VS-86/W4619); cash reconciled (SoD)
Cross-references: - links to W4603 (principal), W4608 (systems), VS-86/W4619 (AML), VS-125 (fraud), VS-08.2 (cash), W4613 (reconciliation), W4614 (KYC)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Account-takeover risk**: Fraudster cashes out a hijacked account (VS-125); mitigated by OTP/verification
- **Float/AML risk**: Cash-in/out used for layering; mitigated by AML thresholds/reporting (VS-86/W4619)
System Touchpoints: - E-money principal (W4603/W4608); AML (VS-86/W4619); cash mgmt (VS-08.2); receipt (VS-79/W4620); GL (VS-17)

steps.activity: Counter Staff process cash-in (customer cash → e-money account credit) or cash-out (e-money debit → customer cash), with customer verification/mobile OTP, via principal (W4603)
Counter Staff apply AML/threshold checks as agent (VS-86/W4619), collect/disperse cash, issue receipt, and capture to VAS system (W4608)
Counter Staff/AML handle threshold exceptions (W4615/W4619), report suspicious activity (VS-86), and reconcile cash (W4613)

Controls: - CTL-699 (ensure controlled execution — Counter Operations — Bills Payment, Remittance, E-Money & Mobile Load (PA-156.2).)
- CTL-699: load confirmed before cash collected; receipt issued (VS-79); commission reconciled (W4617); cash reconciled (SoD)
Cross-references: - links to W4604 (telco), W4608 (systems), VS-08.2 (cash), VS-17 (finance), W4617 (commission/settlement), W4615 (exceptions)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Platform-failure risk**: Load not delivered but cash taken → customer dispute; mitigated by confirm-before-collect & exception handling (W4615)
- **Commission-reconciliation risk**: Load/commission mismatch; mitigated by reconciliation (W4617)
System Touchpoints: - Telco platform (W4604/W4608); cash mgmt (VS-08.2); finance/commission (VS-17/W4617); receipt (VS-79/W4620)

steps.activity: Counter Staff process the load/top-up (mobile number, amount, telco), confirm via platform (W4604/W4608), and collect cash
Counter Staff issue receipt, capture the transaction (commission accrual W4617), and handle any platform failure/exception (W4615)
Counter Staff/Cash Mgmt reconcile load cash at end-of-day (W4613), and Finance settles commission with telco (W4617)

workflows.name: VAS Cash Handling, Custody & End-of-Day Reconciliation

Automation Opportunity: - Cash-transaction reconciliation app; variance-alerting; segregated-cash tracking
Controls: - CTL-93 (ensure VAS agency cash & BSP compliance.)
- CTL-699: SoD (collect/reconcile/post/bank segregated); daily reconciliation; VAS cash segregated; tamper-evident custody (VS-142)
Cross-references: - links to VS-08.2 (cash), VS-18/VS-81 (treasury/CIT), VS-17/VS-21 (finance/audit), VS-142/VS-23 (cash/shrink standard), W4617 (settlement)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Cash-shrinkage risk**: VAS cash skim/shortage (VS-23/VS-142); mitigated by SoD, reconciliation, tamper-evident custody
- **Commingling risk**: VAS cash mixed with retail cash → reconciliation confusion; mitigated by segregation
System Touchpoints: - Cash mgmt (VS-08.2); treasury (VS-18); CIT (VS-81); finance/GL (VS-17); audit (VS-21); COD/cash standard (VS-142)

steps.activity: Counter Staff/Cash Mgmt handle VAS cash with SoD (collect ≠ reconcile ≠ post ≠ bank), tamper-evident custody, and daily remittance limit, per VS-142/W4607 standards
Cash Mgmt reconcile VAS cash to transactions (bills/remittance/e-money/load) end-of-day, investigate variances, and segregate VAS cash from retail cash (VS-08.2)
Treasury/CIT bank the VAS cash (VS-18/VS-81), settle to principals (W4617), and report cash integrity to finance/audit (VS-17/VS-21)

Automation Opportunity: - ID-verification tool; suspicious-pattern screening; secure KYC-data capture
Controls: - CTL-93 (ensure VAS agency cash & BSP compliance.)
- CTL-699: valid-ID KYC for applicable transactions (VS-86); consent obtained (VS-91); data secured/retained per policy (VS-88); suspicious activity reported
Cross-references: - links to VS-86/W4619 (AML), VS-91/VS-88 (privacy/retention), W4603 (principal), VS-21 (audit), W4610/W4611 (transactions)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Inadequate-KYC risk**: Weak ID verification → AML/fraud exposure (VS-86/VS-125); mitigated by mandatory valid-ID & verification
- **Privacy-misuse risk**: KYC data over-collected/misused; mitigated by purpose-limit & secure handling (VS-91)
System Touchpoints: - AML/KYC (VS-86/W4619); privacy (VS-91); records/retention (VS-88); principal integration (W4603); audit (VS-21)

steps.activity: Counter Staff collect & verify customer ID per principal/BSP KYC requirements (valid ID, name, address) for remittance/e-money/threshold transactions, with consent (VS-91)
Counter Staff/AML verify transaction legitimacy (matching name/ID, threshold checks, suspicious-pattern), and escalate red flags (VS-86/W4619)
Privacy/Audit ensure KYC data is captured securely, purpose-limited, retained per policy (VS-88/VS-91), and not misused

Automation Opportunity: - Exception/reversal workflow with SoD; error-pattern analytics; dispute-case management
Controls: - CTL-699 (ensure controlled execution — Counter Operations — Bills Payment, Remittance, E-Money & Mobile Load (PA-156.2).)
- CTL-699: exceptions handled per principal process; reversals SoD-controlled & documented; disputes managed (VS-13/VS-22); recurring causes reduced
Cross-references: - links to W4603/W4604 (principals), VS-17 (finance), VS-13/VS-22 (support/compliance), VS-125 (fraud), W4622 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Reversal-fraud risk**: Fake reversal requests (VS-125); mitigated by SoD, verification & documentation
- **Customer-harm risk**: Unresolved error → complaint/loss; mitigated by SLA & escalation (VS-13)
System Touchpoints: - Principal integration (W4603/W4604); finance/GL (VS-17); customer support (VS-13); fraud (VS-125); analytics (W4622)

steps.activity: Counter Staff/Principals handle posting errors/failures (biller rejection, platform timeout, wrong amount) per principal process, with customer communication
Counter Staff/Finance process reversals/refunds (refund to customer, reversal to principal), with SoD & documentation (avoid reversal-fraud VS-125)
Customer Support/Compliance manage disputes/complaints (VS-13/VS-22), capture exception analytics (W4622), and reduce recurring error causes

Automation Opportunity: - Fee/disclosure display; complaint-case management; complaint-trend analytics
Controls: - CTL-699 (ensure controlled execution — Counter Operations — Bills Payment, Remittance, E-Money & Mobile Load (PA-156.2).)
- CTL-699: fees/commission disclosed (BSP VS-22); agent-not-principal made clear; complaints managed per SLA (VS-13)
Cross-references: - links to VS-13 (CX), VS-22 (compliance), VS-100.3 (legal), W4602–W4604 (principals), W4615 (exceptions), W4620 (reporting)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Disclosure-failure risk**: Undisclosed fees/commission → consumer-protection exposure (VS-22); mitigated by clear disclosure
- **Complaint-escalation risk**: Unresolved → reputation/regulator; mitigated by SLA & fair handling (VS-13)
System Touchpoints: - Customer support (VS-13); compliance (VS-22); principals (W4602–W4604); legal (VS-100.3); marketing (VS-14)

steps.activity: Counter Staff/Customer Support provide VAS customer service (transaction status, fees, receipt), with clear fee/commission disclosure (BSP consumer protection VS-22)
Customer Support/Compliance manage complaints (failed posting, dispute, fee), routing principal-specific to principals, and resolving per SLA (VS-13)
Compliance/Legal ensure disclosure compliance (fees, agent-not-principal, consumer rights RA 7394/BSP), manage escalations, and report complaint trends (VS-22)
